name: Apollo North Pipeline
monitor_reason: endpoints unknown (start point, length and diameter not found); only the Williams page names the case, and no source ties this pipeline itself to the data center
researcher_notes: No existing row matches. Williams, through its subsidiary Will-Power Pipeline OH, lists an Apollo North Pipeline on its Apollo Power Generation Project page, with Ohio Power Siting Board case 26-0275-GA-BLN. The gas-fired plant it serves is next to a Meta data center near Bowling Green, Ohio. The page gives no length, diameter, start point or route for the North line. A local news article from July 2026 describes only the Apollo South line (20 inches, from the Rover Pipeline) and does not mention Apollo North. The state docket page could not be read here. One advocacy source mentions two 16-inch pipelines, which could not be confirmed. Nothing found yet shows what the North line connects to or that it is a separate line from the South one. Recheck when the docket filing is available.
